artifact.self_contained_problem:
For integers $n\ge 0$ and a parameter $x$, define
$$S_n(x)=\sum_{k=0}^{n}\binom{n}{k}^{2}\binom{2k}{k}\,x^{n-k}.$$
For an odd prime $p$, write $\big(\tfrac{a}{p}\big)$ for the Legendre symbol, and for an integer $a$ write $[3\mid a]=1$ if $3\mid a$ and $0$ otherwise (similarly $[5\mid a]$). Decide whether the following two assertions hold.

(i) For every odd prime $p$,
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}S_k(12)\equiv\begin{cases}(-1)^{[3\mid x]}(4x^{2}-2p)\pmod{p^{2}}, & p\equiv 1\pmod{12},\ p=x^{2}+y^{2},\ 4\mid x-1,\\[2pt]\big(\tfrac{xy}{3}\big)\,4xy\pmod{p^{2}}, & p\equiv 5\pmod{12},\ p=x^{2}+y^{2},\ 4\mid x-1,\\[2pt]0\pmod{p^{2}}, & p\equiv 3\pmod{4},\end{cases}$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}(4k+3)\,S_k(12)\equiv p\Big(1+2\big(\tfrac{3}{p}\big)\Big)\pmod{p^{2}},$$
and moreover $n\mid \sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(4k+3)\,S_k(12)$ for all integers $n\ge 1$.

(ii) For every odd prime $p$,
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}S_k(-20)\equiv\begin{cases}(-1)^{[5\mid x]}(4x^{2}-2p)\pmod{p^{2}}, & \big(\tfrac{-1}{p}\big)=\big(\tfrac{p}{5}\big)=1,\ p=x^{2}+y^{2},\ 2\nmid x,\\[2pt]\big(\tfrac{x}{5}\big)\,4xy\pmod{p^{2}}, & \big(\tfrac{-1}{p}\big)=-\big(\tfrac{p}{5}\big)=1,\ p=x^{2}+y^{2},\ 2\nmid x,\ 5\mid xy-1,\\[2pt]0\pmod{p^{2}}, & p\equiv 3\pmod{4},\end{cases}$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}(6k+5)\,S_k(-20)\equiv p\big(\tfrac{-1}{p}\big)\Big(2+3\big(\tfrac{-5}{p}\big)\Big)\pmod{p^{2}},$$
and moreover $n\mid \sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(6k+5)\,S_k(-20)$ for all integers $n\ge 1$.
